basis: Immune dysregulation with autoimmune cytopenias; inflammatory lung infiltration and colitis each reported in roughly half of two cases; dermatitis omitted at cap.
Defined by intracellular edema and structural changes of the buccal mucosa.
Brain malformations and developmental delay define the neurologic component; urethral hypospadias affects 4/4 males. Other genital malformations have no axis.
Benign neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle tissue.
Bacterial infection with variable sites; intestinal colonization does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Choroidal inflammation encompasses infectious and immune-mediated posterior uveitis; no additional systemic vascular involvement is established.
Familial focal epilepsy; associated developmental and autonomic abnormalities remain within the neurologic axis.
Acquired alpha-thalassemia with marrow myelodysplasia and cytopenias; dyspnea does not establish pulmonary damage.
Primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm arising within the central nervous system.
Tuberculosis at multiple sites; the record does not establish a particular organ as affected in at least 30% of this group.
TCTN1-related Joubert syndrome with cerebellar vermis hypoplasia and molar tooth sign in 2/2 patients; no other common organ damage documented.
Multiple bony synostoses define the disorder; otosclerosis is reported but its frequency is insufficiently established for an otologic label.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis. Mesenchymal differentiation does not establish skeletal muscle or bone origin.
Defined by syndromic intellectual disability and pituitary hormone deficiency.
Kaolin dust causes pneumoconiosis affecting lung tissue.
Immune-mediated demyelinating polyneuropathy; ophthalmoplegia reflects neurologic dysfunction. IgM paraprotein alone does not establish blood-cell damage.
Primary systemic fungal infection; direct pulmonary infection occurs in most patients across the major endemic mycoses (>30%). Other dissemination sites vary.
Pathological softening or degeneration of articular cartilage; immune-mediated disease is only a subset.
Cataracts, sensorineural deafness and hypogonadism define the syndrome; intellectual disability occurs in 30-79%. Hypertrichosis omitted at the four-axis cap.
Severe intellectual disability and seizures define this neurodevelopmental syndrome; episodic breathing dysregulation does not establish lung damage.
Hepatitis delta virus directly causes hepatic inflammation; bleeding and confusion are minority complications.
Primary ovarian endocrine failure with elevated gonadotropins in 9/9 patients; adrenal insufficiency is not established by the definition or phenotypes.
Degenerative vascular ectasia predominantly occupies gastrointestinal mucosa and causes bleeding; secondary anemia is separately diagnosed.
Peripheral nerve dysfunction explicitly caused by an underlying endocrine disorder; both neurologic damage and endocrine mechanism define the concept.
Marrow failure, nail/skin disease and oral leukoplakia define DC; pulmonary dysfunction in 4/12 supports involvement. Epiphora alone lacks damage evidence; osteopenia omitted at cap.
